content.value: Photographs at a minimum scale of 1:10000 are to be taken for a road design (08) map of a hilly area having elevation ranges from 300 m to 500 m. If the focal length of the camera is 150 mm then what will be the flying height of the aircraft above MSL? What will be the largest scale?
